original_bug_description: Heap-use-after-free in Zend/zend_closures.c: zend_closure_free_storage can end up invoking zend_string_release on a function name that has already been freed, causing subsequent reads of freed heap memory (seen via zend_string_release and zend_objects_store_del). This use-after-free during closure/object destruction can cause crashes, memory corruption and may be exploitable for information disclosure or arbitrary code execution.
normalized_bug_description: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=4836671271600128: php-src has a reported memory-safety bug. Heap-use-after-free in Zend/zend_closures.c: zend_closure_free_storage can end up invoking zend_string_release on a function name that has already been freed, causing subsequent reads of freed heap memory (seen via zend_string_release and zend_objects_store_del). This use-after-free during closure/object destruction can cause crashes, memory corruption and may be exploitable for information disclosure or arbitrary code execution.
